work_packages.title: Data Harmonisation and Physiological Stress Definition
objectives: Harmonise the 2022-2026 MATE archive into a common-variable matrix
Define the physiological stress target, feature selection and validation protocol

tasks.title: Audit the 2022-2026 MATE archive by variable, year, frequency and replicate structure
Define the common-variable matrix, missingness strategy and effective statistical unit
Select the primary physiological stress target and corroborating endpoints
Identify candidate soil-water, meteorological and proximal spectral stress signatures
Predefine blocked temporal validation and model-selection criteria

work_packages.title: HUN-REN Modelling and ELTE Scale Harmonisation
objectives: Develop and validate the parsimonious primary water-status model
Define spectral/UAV/Sentinel scaling and the crop-transfer specification

tasks.title: Construct process-informed water-status predictors from meteorology, irrigation and soil data
Develop the parsimonious primary model and one nonlinear benchmark where justified
Quantify calibration, uncertainty, interpretability and blocked unseen-year performance
Harmonise proximal/hyperspectral information and define the UAV/Sentinel scale-transition strategy
Configure DrR data structures separating reusable workflows from crop-specific parameters
Define the FIELDWISE crop-transfer specification and recalibration gates

deliverables.title: Primary model, benchmark and model card
Spectral/UAV/Sentinel harmonisation, scaling and crop-transfer specification

dependencies.notes: T2.1/T2.2 operate on the WP1 common-variable matrix and stress target

work_packages.title: Independent Commercial-Farmer Prospective Validation
objectives: Run the independent commercial-farmer prospective validation campaign
Quantify the prospective transfer gap and limited recalibration

tasks.title: Secure written field access and finalise crop/measurement protocol with the farmer collaborator
Install meteorological station and soil sensors; establish data-quality and irrigation-recording procedures
Conduct coordinated physiological, proximal spectral and thermal measurement campaigns
Conduct UAV campaigns and acquire/synchronise Sentinel-2 observations where spatially valid
Apply the historical model prospectively, quantify the transfer gap and evaluate limited recalibration
Activate the Szentendre Skanzen contingency only if primary-site access fails

deliverables.title: Prospective transferability, uncertainty and limited-recalibration report

dependencies.notes: T1.5 criteria and D1.2 protocol govern the WP3 campaign
T3.5 applies the WP2 historical model prospectively

work_packages.title: DrR Web MVP, Co-development and Exploitation Preparation
objectives: Co-develop the crop-configurable DrR web MVP with a validated processing-tomato module
Prepare the exploitation route and placement evaluation protocol

tasks.title: Incrementally improve the existing prototype and implement validated data/model functions
Implement a crop-configurable architecture with explicit crop-specific parameters
Migrate validated core functions toward the DrR web MVP
Use structured AgroVIR consultation from M1 for inputs, usability and interoperability
Perform pre-placement external access testing and prepare the M25-M30 evaluation protocol
Maintain data/IP/background/foreground inventory and define the post-MSCA exploitation route

deliverables.title: Crop-configurable DrR web MVP with validated processing-tomato module

dependencies.notes: T4.2 implements the WP2 reusable/crop-specific separation and crop-transfer specification
D4.1 validated module and T4.3 migration require the WP3 prospective validation

work_packages.title: AgroVIR Non-Academic Placement
objectives: Operationally evaluate the MVP within the AgroVIR FMIS environment
Define the post-MSCA FMIS integration and exploitation roadmap

tasks.title: Evaluate MVP inputs, usability, missing-data behaviour, decision outputs and workflow compatibility
Assess interoperability requirements using protected/coded information where needed
Conduct monthly face-to-face technical reviews alongside routine remote collaboration
Finalise FMIS integration requirements, exploitation roadmap and career-transfer outputs

deliverables.title: Post-MSCA FMIS integration and exploitation roadmap

dependencies.notes: MS4 MVP-ready gate precedes the M25-M30 placement evaluation
